_readme: Overrides for scripts/gen-check-prod.mjs (it writes supabase/CHECK-PROD-MIGRATIONS.sql). Key = migration number or file name.
status: 'optional' = intentionally not applied everywhere (still checked, shown as optional) | 'skip' = nothing to check.
note: shown in the checker's note column. ignore: object labels (exactly as the checker prints them) not to check.
add: extra objects to check, same labels: 'fn public.f(uuid,text)', 'table public.t', 'column public.t.c', 'index public.i',
'policy NAME on public.t', 'trigger NAME on public.t', 'constraint NAME on public.t', 'cron NAME', 'bucket ID',
'publication NAME has public.t', 'marker public.f(args) TEXT' (the function body contains TEXT),
'polexpr NAME on public.t TEXT' (the policy's USING / WITH CHECK expression contains TEXT; NAME may contain spaces).
A migration that makes nothing the parser can see MUST have an entry here (the generator fails otherwise).
